title: Mosul Dam turbine proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: So, this was another proof of concept where they scanned the Mosul Dam.

plain: A team scanned the Mosul Dam in Iraq in 2024 to show that their method could see inside large structures, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum. He calls it "another proof of concept" and links it to the work of Filippo Biondi, but names no other source. He brings it up in a talk about scans of the Egyptian pyramids, because if the method works on a dam, it might also show what lies beneath the pyramids.
